comment: Overall impression: The draft provides a strong and useful foundation for designing interoperable, trustworthy, and human centred digital public infrastructure for health. I particularly value its attention to responsible AI and meaningful human oversight, while seeing scope to strengthen the behavioural and psychosocial dimensions of oversight, including trust calibration, automation bias, vulnerable users, and the conditions under which human review remains substantively effective.
